draft_text: Nimbrake seems to offer somewhat higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve, although this is only a tentative reading of the 142 versus 119 requests-per-second measurements.
revised_text: Nimbrake measured 142 requests per second and Caskline 119 requests per second on Driftbay-Serve, though the figures are not directly comparable because the systems used different batch sizes (32 vs 16).
rationale: Numbers 142 and 119 match T1. However, the table note states the figures are not directly comparable due to different batch sizes (32 vs 16), so asserting "somewhat higher throughput" overstates comparability. No statistical test reported.
